candidate_matrix_default.queue_policy: Design keeps all 64 rows and must include exactly 8 Phase1 Safe-SSDG-CVS-R01 or matched CEN51_R04 source-only DG rows by default: one Phase1 row and seven Phase2 rows per GPU. Runner starts at most one Phase1 candidate and at most three Phase2 lightweight candidates per GPU, then launches same-lane same-GPU backfill slots as active candidates finish until the queue is empty or runtime budget prevents new starts. Safe-SSDG rows that cannot launch immediately because formal Phase1 is active, capacity is full, runtime budget is exhausted, or local implementation is missing remain in the matrix as MONITOR_ONLY_CONTINUE, DEFERRED_RETRY, or LOCAL_PATCH_REQUIRED rows rather than being replaced by legacy meta-learning DG rows.
